words.enDefinition: give the landlord the agreed sum for living there

examples.en: I always pay the rent as soon as my scholarship money arrives.
examples.zh: 奖学金一到账，我就「付房租」。

examples.en: Can you pay the rent this month while I cover the groceries?
examples.zh: 这个月你能「付房租」吗？买菜的钱我来出。

words.enDefinition: receive the money that tenants owe for their accommodation

examples.en: The letting agent will collect rent while our landlord is away this summer.
examples.zh: 房东今年夏天不在，租房中介会代为「收房租」。

examples.en: Our landlord used to collect rent in person on the first Monday of each month.
examples.zh: 以前房东会在每月的第一个星期一上门「收房租」。

collocations: collect rent on behalf of the owner

words.enDefinition: ask tenants to pay more for the same accommodation

examples.en: The owner plans to raise the rent when our current agreement ends.
examples.zh: 我们现在的租约到期后，房东打算「提高房租」。

examples.en: Can the landlord raise the rent before we finish the spring semester?
examples.zh: 春季学期还没结束，房东就能「提高房租」吗？

collocations: raise the rent by ten percent
a decision to raise the rent

words.enDefinition: charge less than the previous price for the accommodation

examples.en: We asked the owner to reduce the rent while the kitchen was unusable.
examples.zh: 厨房没法用的这段时间，我们请房东「降低房租」。

examples.en: The agent offered to reduce the rent if we moved in this week.
examples.zh: 中介说如果我们这周搬进去，可以「降低房租」。

words.enDefinition: still need to pay money for occupying a property

examples.en: The portal says we owe rent for June, but I have the receipt.
examples.zh: 平台显示我们六月还有「房租没交」，可我有收据。

examples.en: I might still owe rent for the week before my flatmate moved in.
examples.zh: 室友搬进来前那一周，我可能还「欠着房租」。

words.enDefinition: provide enough money to pay for the accommodation

examples.en: My research stipend is just enough to cover the rent this semester.
examples.zh: 这学期我的科研津贴刚好够「付房租」。

examples.en: Dad offered to cover the rent until my summer job finally starts.
examples.zh: 爸爸说暑期工作开始前，他可以先帮我「付房租」。

collocations: earn enough to cover the rent

words.enDefinition: fail to keep up with regular payments for housing

examples.en: I could fall behind on rent if my work hours drop again.
examples.zh: 如果工时再减少，我可能会「拖欠房租」。

examples.en: People sometimes fall behind on rent when their scholarship payments arrive late.
examples.zh: 奖学金迟迟不到账，有人就会「拖欠房租」。

collocations: start to fall behind on rent
worry about falling behind on rent

words.enDefinition: pay enough to make overdue housing payments current again

examples.en: I should be able to catch up on rent after my next payday.
examples.zh: 下次发工资后，我应该就能「补齐拖欠的房租」。

examples.en: The adviser helped me make a plan to catch up on rent.
examples.zh: 顾问帮我制定了一个「补齐拖欠房租」的计划。

collocations: catch up on rent by Friday
help someone catch up on rent
a plan to catch up on rent

words.enDefinition: pay the entire housing amount owed for that period

examples.en: The agent expects us to pay rent in full by the first.
examples.zh: 中介要求我们在一号前「全额交租」。

examples.en: Can we pay rent in full once both of our stipends arrive?
examples.zh: 等我们俩的津贴都到账后，可以再「全额交租」吗？

collocations: pay rent in full by Friday
unable to pay rent in full
agree to pay rent in full

words.enDefinition: money sent to cover the cost of renting accommodation

examples.en: My first rent payment came out of my savings account on Monday.
examples.zh: 我的第一笔「房租款」星期一从储蓄账户扣了。

examples.en: I called the office because my rent payment was missing from the portal.
examples.zh: 因为平台上查不到那笔「房租款」，我给办公室打了电话。

words.enDefinition: the amount paid for one week of accommodation

examples.en: The weekly rent looks affordable until you add the cost of commuting.
examples.zh: 这个「周租金」看起来还负担得起，但加上通勤费就不一样了。

examples.en: Could you confirm the weekly rent before we book a second viewing?
examples.zh: 我们约第二次看房前，能请您确认一下「周租金」吗？

collocations: weekly rent of two hundred pounds

words.enDefinition: the total cost of renting accommodation for a year

examples.en: I worked out the annual rent before deciding whether to live off campus.
examples.zh: 决定是否住校外之前，我算了算「年租金」。

examples.en: The landlord quoted the annual rent, so we divided it by twelve.
examples.zh: 房东报的是「年租金」，我们就把它除以十二。

words.enDefinition: the day by which regular rent must be paid

examples.en: I put the rent due date on the calendar we share at home.
examples.zh: 我把「房租到期日」记在了家里的共享日历上。

examples.en: The rent due date is on a Sunday this month, so I paid early.
examples.zh: 这个月的「房租到期日」是星期天，所以我提前付了。

words.enDefinition: a change to a higher price for renting housing

examples.en: Our landlord mentioned a rent increase when we asked about staying another year.
examples.zh: 我们问能不能再住一年时，房东提到了「房租上涨」的事。

examples.en: A rent increase would leave me with less money for next semester's textbooks.
examples.zh: 要是「房租上涨」，我下学期买教材的钱就会少一些。

words.enDefinition: a decrease in the price paid for rented housing

examples.en: The agent offered a rent reduction while the bathroom was being rebuilt.
examples.zh: 卫生间翻修期间，中介提出可以「下调房租」。

examples.en: We sent photos of the damage when we requested a rent reduction.
examples.zh: 申请「下调房租」时，我们一并发去了受损部位的照片。

words.enDefinition: a period when the rent cannot be increased

examples.en: The housing office announced a rent freeze for students next academic year.
examples.zh: 住宿办公室宣布下学年对学生实行「租金冻结」。

examples.en: We signed for another year after getting a rent freeze in writing.
examples.zh: 拿到「租金冻结」的书面承诺后，我们又签了一年。

words.enDefinition: a maximum allowed amount of rent for certain housing

examples.en: I asked whether the new rent cap applied to our building too.
examples.zh: 我问了新的「租金上限」是否也适用于我们这栋楼。

examples.en: The student union is asking for a rent cap in university housing.
examples.zh: 学生会呼吁给学校宿舍设定「租金上限」。

words.enDefinition: a temporary reduction or suspension of rent normally due

examples.en: We asked for rent abatement after the flood made our room unusable.
examples.zh: 房间被淹后没法住，我们申请了「租金减免」。

examples.en: The adviser explained how to request rent abatement while repairs were underway.
examples.zh: 顾问告诉我们，在维修期间怎么申请「租金减免」。

words.enDefinition: a discount or other financial incentive offered to renters

examples.en: The building manager offered a rent concession if I signed before September.
examples.zh: 楼管说如果我在九月前签约，可以给我「租金优惠」。

examples.en: The advertised rent concession applies only to people taking a twelve-month contract.
examples.zh: 广告上的「租金优惠」只适用于签十二个月合同的人。

words.enDefinition: rent still owed for earlier months of a tenancy

examples.en: I used my first paycheck to pay the back rent for May.
examples.zh: 我用第一笔工资补交了五月的「积欠租金」。

examples.en: The landlord says I owe back rent, but my receipts show otherwise.
examples.zh: 房东说我还有「积欠租金」，但收据显示并不是这样。

words.enDefinition: the amount of rent remaining to be paid

examples.en: I checked my rent balance before sending the rest of my payment.
examples.zh: 我先核对了「房租欠款余额」，再把剩下的钱转过去。

examples.en: The portal should show a zero rent balance after the transfer clears.
examples.zh: 转账结算后，平台显示的「房租欠款余额」应该是零。

words.enDefinition: the amount by which available money falls short of rent

examples.en: My new flatmate offered to cover the rent shortfall until the grant arrived.
examples.zh: 新室友说资助款到账前，他可以先帮我补上「房租缺口」。

examples.en: I emailed the student welfare team about a rent shortfall this month.
examples.zh: 这个月房租有「资金缺口」，我给学生福利部门发了邮件。

words.enDefinition: a running record of rent charges and payments

examples.en: Could you send us the rent ledger for the last three months?
examples.zh: 能把过去三个月的「租金明细账」发给我们吗？

examples.en: The rent ledger shows my May transfer but not the one in June.
examples.zh: 「租金明细账」里有我五月的转账，却没有六月那笔。

collocations: request a copy of the rent ledger

words.enDefinition: a document showing rent charges and payments for a period

examples.en: I checked the rent statement and found a payment listed under the wrong date.
examples.zh: 我核对「租金对账单」时发现，有笔付款的日期记错了。

examples.en: The agent sent a rent statement that covered my whole first semester.
examples.zh: 中介发来了一份涵盖我整个第一学期的「租金对账单」。

words.enDefinition: written proof that a landlord received a rent payment

examples.en: My landlord gave me a rent receipt when I paid in cash.
examples.zh: 我用现金交租时，房东给了我一张「房租收据」。

examples.en: I saved the rent receipt in case the housing office asked for proof.
examples.zh: 我把「房租收据」留了下来，以防住宿办公室要我提供付款证明。

collocations: keep a copy of the rent receipt

words.enDefinition: a document that lists the rent being charged

examples.en: The rent invoice lists our apartment number and the amount we owe.
examples.zh: 「租金账单」上写着公寓门牌号和应付金额。

examples.en: I emailed the office because the rent invoice showed the wrong month.
examples.zh: 由于「租金账单」上的月份写错了，我给办公室发了邮件。

words.enDefinition: a message asking tenants to remember a rent payment

examples.en: I got a rent reminder even though I had already sent the money.
examples.zh: 虽然我已经转了钱，但还是收到了「交租提醒」。

examples.en: The agent sends a rent reminder three days before each payment is due.
examples.zh: 每笔房租到期前三天，中介都会发一条「交租提醒」。

words.enDefinition: evidence showing that money was paid for rented accommodation

examples.en: The bursary office asked for proof of rent payment before reviewing my application.
examples.zh: 助学金办公室要我先提供「交租凭证」，然后才审核申请。

examples.en: I uploaded proof of rent payment after the portal marked my account overdue.
examples.zh: 平台标记我逾期后，我上传了「交租凭证」。

collocations: ask for proof of rent payment

words.enDefinition: an identifying note or code entered when sending a payment

examples.en: Use your room number as the payment reference when you send the transfer.
examples.zh: 转账时请在「付款附言」里填上你的房间号。

examples.en: I forgot to enter the payment reference, so the office could not match my transfer.
examples.zh: 我忘了填「付款附言」，办公室没法识别这笔转账。

words.enDefinition: an agreed schedule for paying an amount in stages

examples.en: The agent agreed to a payment plan when my stipend was delayed.
examples.zh: 我的津贴延迟到账，中介同意了「分期付款计划」。

examples.en: I asked whether the payment plan would cover both months of overdue rent.
examples.zh: 我问了「分期付款计划」是否包含拖欠的两个月房租。

words.enDefinition: additional time officially granted to make a payment

examples.en: I asked for a payment extension because my new bank account was still blocked.
examples.zh: 新开的银行账户还用不了，所以我申请「延长付款期限」。

examples.en: The owner offered a payment extension until the end of next week.
examples.zh: 房东提出把「付款期限延长」到下周末。

words.enDefinition: a record of when and how payments were made

examples.en: I downloaded my payment history before the landlord closed my portal account.
examples.zh: 房东关闭我的平台账户前，我下载了「付款记录」。

examples.en: The housing adviser checked my payment history for gaps before calling the agent.
examples.zh: 住宿顾问先看了我的「付款记录」有没有漏记，再给中介打电话。

words.enDefinition: a payment set up to go through on a chosen date

examples.en: I moved the scheduled payment to Friday because Thursday is a bank holiday.
examples.zh: 星期四银行放假，我把「预约付款」改到了星期五。

examples.en: The scheduled payment will go through before my morning lecture on Monday.
examples.zh: 这笔「预约付款」会在星期一早课前转出。

words.enDefinition: a payment repeated automatically at regular intervals

examples.en: I set up a recurring payment for the first of every month.
examples.zh: 我设置了每月一号的「定期付款」。

examples.en: Remember to cancel the recurring payment after you send your final rent.
examples.zh: 最后一笔房租付完后，记得取消「定期付款」。

words.enDefinition: how often a payment is made or required

examples.en: The portal lets me choose my payment frequency before I confirm the arrangement.
examples.zh: 确认付款安排前，我可以在平台上选择「付款频率」。

examples.en: I asked about the payment frequency because my wages come in every Friday.
examples.zh: 我每周五领工资，所以问了「付款频率」。

words.enDefinition: one in a series of amounts due each month

examples.en: Our halls ask for one monthly installment rather than the full sum upfront.
examples.zh: 宿舍只要求逐月交「分期款」，不用一次付清。

examples.en: The final monthly installment for my dorm room is due during exams.
examples.zh: 我宿舍费最后一笔「月度分期款」在考试期间到期。

words.enDefinition: rent adjusted to reflect only part of the rental period

examples.en: The portal shows prorated rent because I moved in halfway through the month.
examples.zh: 因为我是月中搬进去的，平台显示的是「按比例计收的房租」。

examples.en: I asked for a breakdown of the prorated rent before paying the bill.
examples.zh: 付账前，我要了「按比例计收的房租」的计算明细。

words.enDefinition: calculate the charge for a shorter part of the rental period

examples.en: Could you prorate the rent if I cannot move in before the twentieth?
examples.zh: 如果我要到二十号才能搬进去，能「按比例计算房租」吗？

examples.en: The agent said they could prorate the rent for my final week.
examples.zh: 中介说他们可以把最后一周的「房租按比例计算」。

collocations: prorate the rent by the day
prorate the rent for the first month

words.enDefinition: money already credited that can reduce an upcoming rent payment

examples.en: The landlord offered a credit toward rent for the days without hot water.
examples.zh: 没有热水的那几天，房东给了一笔「可抵扣房租的款项」。

examples.en: My account shows a credit toward rent from an overpayment last month.
examples.zh: 账户上显示一笔「可抵扣房租的款项」，是上个月多交的钱。

words.enDefinition: record an available amount against an account or charge

examples.en: Could you apply a credit to my next bill instead of refunding the money?
examples.zh: 能把这笔钱「记成下期账单的抵扣款」，不用退款吗？

examples.en: The office agreed to apply a credit before collecting the August rent.
examples.zh: 办公室同意在收八月房租前先把「抵扣款入账」。

collocations: apply a credit to your account
apply a credit to the balance
ask the office to apply a credit

words.enDefinition: pay everything that remains owed on an account

examples.en: I can settle the balance on Monday after the university releases my grant.
examples.zh: 学校发放补助后，我星期一就能「结清余款」。

examples.en: Please send the updated total so we can settle the balance before moving out.
examples.zh: 请发来更新后的总额，我们好在搬走前「结清余款」。

words.enDefinition: pay off amounts that should already have been paid

examples.en: I agreed to clear the arrears in three payments over the summer.
examples.zh: 我同意暑假分三次「付清欠款」。

examples.en: The adviser helped me clear the arrears before my next rent became due.
examples.zh: 在下一笔房租到期前，顾问帮我「付清了欠款」。

words.enDefinition: formally question whether an amount billed is correct

examples.en: I had to dispute a charge after the portal billed me twice.
examples.zh: 平台扣了我两次钱，我只能「对这笔收费提出异议」。

examples.en: You can dispute a charge by emailing the office with your transfer receipt.
examples.zh: 你可以把转账收据发给办公室，「对收费提出异议」。

collocations: dispute a charge on the portal
a deadline to dispute a charge

words.enDefinition: undo a recorded payment so it no longer counts

examples.en: The agent can reverse a payment if it was entered against the wrong flat.
examples.zh: 如果付款记到了别的公寓名下，中介可以「冲销这笔付款」。

examples.en: I asked whether the bank could reverse a payment made to the old agent.
examples.zh: 我问银行能不能把误付给原来中介的那笔「付款冲销」。

collocations: reverse a payment made in error

words.enDefinition: the same amount being paid twice for one charge

examples.en: My flatmate spotted a duplicate payment when she checked our shared account.
examples.zh: 室友查我们的共同账户时，发现有一笔「重复付款」。

examples.en: Please contact the rent office if a duplicate payment appears on your statement.
examples.zh: 如果对账单上出现「重复付款」，请联系房租管理办公室。

words.enDefinition: pay more than the amount due for the accommodation

examples.en: I might overpay the rent if I leave both automatic transfers active.
examples.zh: 如果两笔自动转账都不取消，我可能会「多交房租」。

examples.en: Check the credit on your account so you do not overpay the rent.
examples.zh: 检查一下账户里的抵扣余额，以免「多交房租」。

collocations: avoid having to overpay the rent

words.enDefinition: pay less than the amount owed for the accommodation

examples.en: I might underpay the rent if I forget to update my standing order.
examples.zh: 要是忘了更新定期转账指令，我可能会「少交房租」。

examples.en: Check the exchange rate first so you do not underpay the rent.
examples.zh: 先查一下汇率，以免「少交房租」。

words.enDefinition: a mismatch between a payment and how it appears in records

examples.en: I reported a payment discrepancy after comparing my bank app with the rent portal.
examples.zh: 我对照银行应用和房租平台，发现「付款记录有差异」后就报了上去。

examples.en: The office asked for a screenshot to resolve the payment discrepancy on my account.
examples.zh: 办公室让我提供截图，以核实我账户里的「付款记录差异」。

words.enDefinition: money sent or expected but absent from a record

examples.en: I called the agent about a missing payment and read out my reference number.
examples.zh: 我为一笔「查不到的付款」给中介打电话，报了付款编号。

examples.en: The office finally found the missing payment under my old room number.
examples.zh: 办公室最后在我原来的房间号下找到了那笔「查不到的付款」。

words.enDefinition: money received but not yet assigned to a specific charge

examples.en: There is an unapplied payment on the account, even though July still shows as overdue.
examples.zh: 账户里有一笔「未冲抵账款的付款」，但平台仍显示七月房租逾期。

examples.en: Could the unapplied payment be the transfer I sent without a reference?
examples.zh: 那笔「未冲抵账款的付款」会不会是我忘填附言的转账？

collocations: an unapplied payment on an account

words.enDefinition: a payment sent back because it could not go through

examples.en: A returned payment showed up after my bank switched my checking account.
examples.zh: 银行更换我的支票账户后，有笔「付款被退回了」。

examples.en: The portal shows a returned payment, but my bank cannot explain why.
examples.zh: 平台显示有笔「付款被退回了」，但银行说不清原因。

words.enDefinition: a check the bank could not pay

examples.en: I replaced the bounced check with a money order later that afternoon.
examples.zh: 当天下午晚些时候，我用汇票替换了那张「被退票的支票」。

examples.en: The office called about a bounced check I had written for June rent.
examples.zh: 关于我六月交租那张「被退票的支票」，办公室给我打了电话。

collocations: a fee for a bounced check
notify someone of a bounced check

words.enDefinition: an instruction telling a bank not to honor a payment

examples.en: I put a stop payment on the check after it went missing.
examples.zh: 支票丢了之后，我给这张支票办了「止付」。

examples.en: The bank suggested a stop payment before I mailed the landlord a replacement check.
examples.zh: 银行建议我先办「止付」，再给房东寄一张新支票。

collocations: place a stop payment on a check

words.enDefinition: a lack of enough money for a requested payment

examples.en: My rent transfer failed due to insufficient funds in my checking account.
examples.zh: 因为支票账户「余额不足」，我的房租转账失败了。

examples.en: I saw an insufficient funds notice before the office contacted me about rent.
examples.zh: 办公室联系我谈房租之前，我就看到了「账户余额不足」的通知。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement letting an organization pull funds from an account

examples.en: I set up a direct debit so the housing office can collect rent automatically.
examples.zh: 我办了「授权自动扣款」，住宿办公室就能自动收房租。

examples.en: The direct debit came out earlier than I expected after the long weekend.
examples.zh: 长周末之后，这笔「授权扣款」比我预想的早。

words.enDefinition: an electronic transfer of funds between banks, often internationally

examples.en: My parents sent a wire transfer so I could cover two months of rent.
examples.zh: 父母通过「电汇」给我转了钱，让我能付两个月的房租。

examples.en: Please let us know when the wire transfer reaches the landlord's account.
examples.zh: 「电汇」汇入房东账户后，麻烦通知我们。

words.enDefinition: a prepaid document used to send money to someone

examples.en: I bought a money order at the post office to pay my rent.
examples.zh: 我在邮局买了一张「汇票」交房租。

examples.en: The front desk said I could use a money order instead of cash.
examples.zh: 前台说我可以用「汇票」代替现金。

collocations: make a money order payable to someone

words.enDefinition: a check issued and guaranteed by a bank

examples.en: I got a cashier's check because the office would not accept a personal one.
examples.zh: 办公室不收个人支票，所以我开了一张「银行本票」。

examples.en: The teller asked who should be listed as payee on the cashier's check.
examples.zh: 柜员问我「银行本票」的收款人应该写谁。

collocations: a cashier's check payable to the landlord

words.enDefinition: a check written against an individual's bank account

examples.en: The agent will take a personal check if I bring it before closing.
examples.zh: 只要关门前把「个人支票」送过去，中介就收。

examples.en: I wrote a personal check for rent and put it in a sealed envelope.
examples.zh: 我开了一张「个人支票」交房租，把它放进了封好的信封。

words.enDefinition: a check dated for a later day

examples.en: The agent asked for a postdated check for the first of December.
examples.zh: 中介要了一张日期写为十二月一号的「远期支票」。

examples.en: I left a postdated check with my roommate before going home for winter break.
examples.zh: 寒假回家前，我留了一张「远期支票」给室友。

words.enDefinition: a US bank transfer through the automated clearing house network

examples.en: An ACH transfer is cheaper than paying my rent with a credit card.
examples.zh: 通过「美国清算网络转账」付房租，比刷信用卡便宜。

examples.en: The rent office asked me to allow two days for the ACH transfer.
examples.zh: 房租办公室让我为这笔「美国清算网络转账」预留两天时间。

words.enDefinition: a Canadian bank transfer sent using an email address or mobile number

examples.en: My landlord in Toronto prefers an e-transfer to a check for rent.
examples.zh: 我在多伦多的房东更喜欢用「电子转账」收房租，胜过收支票。

examples.en: I sent an e-transfer to the email address listed on the rent notice.
examples.zh: 我用交租通知上写的电子邮箱地址发了一笔「电子转账」。

words.enDefinition: a bank service for sending scheduled payments to payees online

examples.en: My bank offers online bill pay, so I stopped mailing rent checks myself.
examples.zh: 银行有「网上账单支付」服务，所以我不用自己寄房租支票了。

examples.en: I set up online bill pay with the address on the rent statement.
examples.zh: 我用租金对账单上的地址设置了「网上账单支付」。

collocations: sign in to online bill pay

words.enDefinition: a website for renters to manage their accounts

examples.en: I use the tenant portal to check when my rent payments arrive.
examples.zh: 我通过「租户服务平台」查看每笔房租什么时候到账。

examples.en: The tenant portal is down, so I called the office about my payment.
examples.zh: 「租户服务平台」打不开，我就打电话给办公室问了付款的事。

collocations: log in to the tenant portal

words.enDefinition: a web address that takes someone to a payment page

examples.en: The office sent a payment link after I reported a problem with the portal.
examples.zh: 我反映平台出了故障，办公室就发来一个「付款链接」。

examples.en: The payment link expired before my roommate could send her share of rent.
examples.zh: 室友还没来得及付她那份房租，「付款链接」就失效了。

words.enDefinition: use a written check to settle an amount owed

examples.en: Can I pay by check while I wait for my debit card?
examples.zh: 借记卡还没寄到，我能先「用支票付款」吗？

examples.en: We still pay by check because the landlord lives in the same building.
examples.zh: 因为房东就住在同一栋楼，我们还是「用支票付款」。

collocations: allow tenants to pay by check

words.enDefinition: hand over notes or coins to settle a bill

examples.en: If you pay in cash, ask the landlord for a receipt that day.
examples.zh: 如果你「用现金付款」，当天就找房东要收据。

examples.en: I had to pay in cash because my new card had not arrived.
examples.zh: 新卡还没寄到，我只好「用现金付款」。

collocations: allow tenants to pay in cash

words.enDefinition: use a debit or credit card to make a payment

examples.en: Can I pay by card at the housing office after my lecture?
examples.zh: 下课后我可以去住宿办公室「刷卡付款」吗？

examples.en: Some tenants pay by card because it is quicker than mailing a check.
examples.zh: 有些房客会「刷卡付款」，因为比邮寄支票快。

collocations: allow customers to pay by card

words.enDefinition: arrange for future payments to be made automatically

examples.en: I decided to set up autopay before leaving for my exchange semester.
examples.zh: 去交换学习前，我决定「设置自动付款」。

examples.en: The site lets you set up autopay after you confirm your bank details.
examples.zh: 确认银行账户信息后，你就可以在网站上「设置自动付款」。

collocations: set up autopay with a debit card

words.enDefinition: stop scheduled automatic payments from going through

examples.en: I need to cancel autopay before the new tenant starts paying in August.
examples.zh: 八月新租户开始交租前，我得「取消自动付款」。

examples.en: Please cancel autopay after confirming that your last payment has gone through.
examples.zh: 请在确认最后一笔款项成功支付后「取消自动付款」。

words.enDefinition: change saved information used to process future payments

examples.en: I had to update payment details after my bank sent a replacement card.
examples.zh: 银行寄来补办的卡后，我得「更新付款信息」。

examples.en: The portal asked me to update payment details before the next rent was due.
examples.zh: 平台要求我在下一次交租前「更新付款信息」。

collocations: remind someone to update payment details

words.enDefinition: an extra amount billed because a payment was late

examples.en: The office added a late charge even though I paid on Friday.
examples.zh: 虽然我星期五已经付了钱，办公室还是加收了「逾期费」。

examples.en: I paid before the weekend to avoid a late charge on my rent.
examples.zh: 为了不让房租产生「逾期费」，我在周末前就付了。

words.enDefinition: a message saying a required payment missed its deadline

examples.en: I received a late payment notice while I was away on a field trip.
examples.zh: 我在外参加实地考察时收到了一封「付款逾期通知」。

examples.en: I replied to the late payment notice with a copy of my receipt.
examples.zh: 我回复了那封「付款逾期通知」，附上了一份收据。

collocations: respond to a late payment notice

words.enDefinition: decide not to collect a fee for paying late

examples.en: The manager offered to waive a late fee after seeing my bank receipt.
examples.zh: 经理看过银行收据后，提出可以「免收逾期费」。

examples.en: I asked whether the landlord would waive a late fee this one time.
examples.zh: 我问房东这一次能不能「免收逾期费」。

collocations: agree to waive a late fee
offer to waive a late fee
ask the landlord to waive a late fee

words.enDefinition: the part of the rent that one person pays

examples.en: My share of the rent is higher because I have the bigger room.
examples.zh: 我住的是大房间，所以我「应分摊的房租」更高。

examples.en: I sent my share of the rent before leaving campus for the weekend.
examples.zh: 周末离校前，我把「自己那份房租」转了过去。

collocations: pay your share of the rent
cover someone's share of the rent
calculate each person's share of the rent

words.enDefinition: an arrangement in which everyone pays the same amount

examples.en: We agreed to an equal split because our rooms were almost identical.
examples.zh: 我们的房间几乎一样，所以同意房租「平均分摊」。

examples.en: An equal split keeps the monthly payments simple for all three roommates.
examples.zh: 「平均分摊」让三个室友每月付钱都省事。

words.enDefinition: an arrangement for dividing the rent among several people

examples.en: We discussed the rent split before deciding who would take each bedroom.
examples.zh: 我们先讨论了「房租分摊方案」，再决定各住哪间卧室。

examples.en: The rent split changed when our fourth flatmate moved in last spring.
examples.zh: 去年春天第四个室友搬进来后，「房租分摊方案」变了。

words.enDefinition: contribute some money toward a shared rent payment

examples.en: My partner offered to chip in for rent while staying over this summer.
examples.zh: 我对象说这个夏天过来住的时候，愿意「凑一份房租钱」。

examples.en: Can everyone chip in for rent before I send the landlord our payment?
examples.zh: 我把钱转给房东之前，大家能先「凑齐各自那份房租」吗？

collocations: offer to chip in for rent
agree to chip in for rent
ask someone to chip in for rent

words.enDefinition: send the portion of a shared bill that you owe

examples.en: Please transfer your share by Thursday so I can pay the landlord on time.
examples.zh: 请在星期四前「把自己那份转过来」，我好按时交给房东。

examples.en: You can transfer your share separately if our flatmate has already paid hers.
examples.zh: 如果室友已经付过，你可以单独「转账付自己那份」。

collocations: transfer your share to a roommate

words.enDefinition: pay another person's part of a shared cost

examples.en: I can cover your share this month if your grant is coming late.
examples.zh: 如果补助款晚到，这个月我可以先「垫付你那份」。

examples.en: Could you cover her share of the rent until she gets paid again?
examples.zh: 她下次领到工资之前，你能先「垫付她那份」房租吗？

collocations: cover someone's share for a week

words.enDefinition: the latest time by which a payment must be made

examples.en: The payment deadline for the replacement key is Friday, but I can pay today.
examples.zh: 补配钥匙的「付款截止日」是周五，但我今天就可以付。

examples.en: The housing office moved the payment deadline because the portal was down.
examples.zh: 由于平台无法使用，住宿办公室推迟了「付款截止日」。

words.enDefinition: plan how much money to reserve for upcoming rent

examples.en: I budget for rent before deciding how much I can spend on groceries.
examples.zh: 我先「为房租做预算」，再决定买菜能花多少钱。

examples.en: The guide shows how to budget for rent on a part-time income.
examples.zh: 这份指南教你怎么用兼职收入「为房租做预算」。

words.enDefinition: save a portion of your funds for paying rent

examples.en: I set aside rent money as soon as my wages reach my account.
examples.zh: 工资一到账，我就先「留出房租钱」。

examples.en: We set aside rent money before booking our train tickets for spring break.
examples.zh: 订春假火车票前，我们先「留出了房租钱」。

collocations: remember to set aside rent money

words.enDefinition: the financial pressure caused by the cost of rent

examples.en: Sharing with a third student helped reduce our rent burden last year.
examples.zh: 去年多找一个同学合租，减轻了我们的「房租负担」。

examples.en: My rent burden increased when I lost one of my weekend shifts.
examples.zh: 少上了一次周末班后，我的「房租负担」加重了。

words.enDefinition: the proportion of someone's income spent on rent

examples.en: I checked my rent-to-income ratio before deciding whether I could afford a studio.
examples.zh: 决定能不能租单间公寓前，我算了算自己的「房租收入比」。

examples.en: The adviser used my rent-to-income ratio to explain why my budget felt tight.
examples.zh: 顾问用我的「房租收入比」解释为什么我的预算总是紧张。

words.enDefinition: the gap between actual income and the money needed

examples.en: I turned to the student support office after an unexpected income shortfall.
examples.zh: 遇到意外的「收入缺口」后，我向学生支持办公室求助。

examples.en: A small grant helped cover my income shortfall during the summer term.
examples.zh: 一笔小额补助帮我填上了夏季学期的「收入缺口」。

words.zhGloss: 困难期间分期付款安排
words.enDefinition: an installment arrangement for a person experiencing financial difficulty
acceptedZhAnswers: 困难期间分期付款安排

examples.en: The university offered a hardship payment plan after I explained my situation.
examples.zh: 我说明情况后，学校提供了「困难期间分期付款安排」。

examples.en: Can I apply for a hardship payment plan before my rent is overdue?
examples.zh: 房租逾期前，我能申请「困难期间分期付款安排」吗？

collocations: qualify for a hardship payment plan

words.enDefinition: temporary help paying for housing during a financial crisis

examples.en: The student union helped me apply for emergency rental assistance on Tuesday.
examples.zh: 学生会帮我在星期二申请了「紧急租房援助」。

examples.en: Emergency rental assistance helped him stay housed while he waited for his first paycheck.
examples.zh: 第一次发工资前，「紧急租房援助」让他还能继续有地方住。

words.enDefinition: money provided to help someone pay for accommodation

examples.en: My scholarship includes a housing allowance that covers part of my weekly rent.
examples.zh: 我的奖学金里有「住房津贴」，能覆盖一部分周租金。

examples.en: I asked whether the housing allowance would continue during the summer break.
examples.zh: 我问了暑假期间「住房津贴」会不会继续发放。

words.enDefinition: official assistance that can pay part of eligible housing costs

examples.en: My aunt asked whether the landlord would accept a housing voucher from the city.
examples.zh: 我姨妈问房东愿不愿意接受市里发的「住房补助券」。

examples.en: The adviser explained which apartments near campus would accept a housing voucher.
examples.zh: 顾问介绍了学校附近哪些公寓接受「住房补助券」。

words.enDefinition: the person or organization named to receive a payment

examples.en: The payee on my rent check is the housing company, not the agent.
examples.zh: 我的房租支票上，「收款人」写的是住房公司，而不是中介。

examples.en: I checked the payee before sending money to the new management company.
examples.zh: 给新的物业管理公司转账前，我核对了「收款人」。

words.enDefinition: a payment made with a credit or debit card

examples.en: The office refused a card payment during a temporary outage last Monday.
examples.zh: 上星期一系统临时故障，办公室不收「银行卡付款」。

examples.en: My card payment appeared in the rent portal by the end of class.
examples.zh: 到下课时，我的「银行卡付款」已经显示在交租平台里了。

words.enDefinition: an extra charge for paying by credit card

examples.en: I used a check instead to avoid the credit card surcharge on rent.
examples.zh: 为省下交租的「信用卡附加费」，我改用支票付了。

examples.en: The portal shows the credit card surcharge before you confirm the payment.
examples.zh: 平台会在你确认付款前显示「信用卡附加费」。

words.enDefinition: an extra charge for using a particular payment option

examples.en: There is a convenience fee if I use the agent's online payment link.
examples.zh: 用中介的网上付款链接，会收一笔「支付渠道服务费」。

examples.en: We pay by check because the portal adds a convenience fee every month.
examples.zh: 我们用支票付，因为用平台每个月都会加收「支付渠道服务费」。

words.enDefinition: the maximum amount that can be sent by transfer

examples.en: I reached my transfer limit before I sent the rest of the rent.
examples.zh: 最后一部分房租还没付，我就达到了「转账限额」。

examples.en: The bank raised my transfer limit for one day so I could pay rent.
examples.zh: 银行把我的「转账限额」临时提高了一天，这样我就能交房租了。

words.enDefinition: a code identifying the bank for a US payment

examples.en: I checked the routing number twice before setting up my rent transfer.
examples.zh: 设置房租转账前，我核对了两遍「美国银行识别号」。

examples.en: The portal asks for a routing number and the number of my checking account.
examples.zh: 平台要我填「美国银行识别号」以及支票账户的账号。

words.enDefinition: a code identifying a UK bank and branch

examples.en: The agent sent the sort code separately from the landlord's account number.
examples.zh: 中介把「英国银行分行代码」和房东的银行账号分开发给了我。

examples.en: Check the sort code before sending rent to the new property manager.
examples.zh: 给新物业经理交租前，请核对「英国银行分行代码」。

words.enDefinition: the unique number assigned to a receipt

examples.en: I quoted the receipt number when I called about the missing rent payment.
examples.zh: 我打电话查询查不到的房租时，报了「收据编号」。

examples.en: Keep the receipt number until the housing office confirms your payment has arrived.
examples.zh: 请保留「收据编号」，直到住宿办公室确认款项到账。

words.enDefinition: a unique identifier for a particular financial transaction

examples.en: The agent asked for the transaction ID so she could locate my payment.
examples.zh: 中介要我提供「交易编号」，这样她就能查到我的付款。

examples.en: I copied the transaction ID from my bank app into the message.
examples.zh: 我把银行应用里的「交易编号」复制到了消息里。

words.enDefinition: documentation showing that money was sent by bank transfer

examples.en: Please attach proof of transfer when you email the rent office about July.
examples.zh: 给房租办公室发邮件询问七月房租时，请附上「转账凭证」。

examples.en: I sent my flatmate proof of transfer so she could update our spreadsheet.
examples.zh: 我把「转账凭证」发给室友，好让她更新我们的表格。

words.enDefinition: exchange a specific check for money in cash

examples.en: The landlord plans to cash the check tomorrow on her way to work.
examples.zh: 房东打算明天上班路上「把支票兑成现金」。

examples.en: My agent could not cash the check because I misspelled the company name.
examples.zh: 我把公司名称拼错了，中介没法「兑现支票」。

collocations: cash the check at a bank

words.enDefinition: the banking process of confirming and settling a check

examples.en: My landlord asks us to allow two business days for check clearing.
examples.zh: 房东让我们为「支票清算」预留两个工作日。

examples.en: I chose to pay by card because check clearing takes longer over holidays.
examples.zh: 节假日「支票清算」更慢，所以我选择刷卡付款。

words.enDefinition: the amount in an account that can currently be spent

examples.en: I checked my available balance before buying my textbooks and paying rent.
examples.zh: 买教材和交房租之前，我查看了自己的「可用余额」。

examples.en: The rent payment reduced my available balance before it showed on my statement.
examples.zh: 房租付款还没显示在对账单上，我的「可用余额」就已经少了。

words.enDefinition: the span of time covered by charges on a bill

examples.en: I checked the billing period because the amount looked high for two weeks.
examples.zh: 这个金额对两周来说显得有点高，于是我核对了「账单周期」。

examples.en: The billing period on our rent statement runs from Monday through the following Sunday.
examples.zh: 我们的租金对账单上的「账单周期」是星期一到下一周的星期天。

words.enDefinition: the amount carried forward from the previous account statement

examples.en: The previous balance was zero, so I only paid this month's rent.
examples.zh: 「上期余额」为零，所以我只付了这个月的房租。

examples.en: I questioned the previous balance because it still included a charge I had paid.
examples.zh: 「上期余额」里还有一笔我已经结清的费用，我因此提出了疑问。

words.enDefinition: money in an account available to offset new charges

examples.en: My account shows a credit balance after I accidentally paid rent twice.
examples.zh: 我不小心交了两次房租，账户上就有了「抵扣余额」。

examples.en: Can I use the credit balance toward the rent due next month?
examples.zh: 我能用这笔「账户抵扣余额」抵下个月的房租吗？

words.enDefinition: the amount that still needs to be paid

examples.en: The balance due was smaller because the agent applied my earlier credit.
examples.zh: 中介用了我之前的抵扣款，所以「应付余额」少了。

examples.en: Could you confirm the balance due before I send my final transfer?
examples.zh: 我转最后一笔款前，能请您确认一下「应付余额」吗？

words.enDefinition: the total sum recorded as having arrived

examples.en: The amount received was slightly lower because the sending bank deducted a fee.
examples.zh: 汇款银行扣了一笔手续费，所以「实收金额」少一点。

examples.en: Please check the amount received before you mark our rent as unpaid.
examples.zh: 把我们的房租标成未付款之前，请核对一下「实收金额」。

words.enDefinition: the day on which money is paid or scheduled

examples.en: My bank and the rent portal show a different payment date for June.
examples.zh: 银行和房租平台显示的六月「付款日期」不一样。

examples.en: Can I move the payment date to the day after my stipend arrives?
examples.zh: 我能把「付款日期」改到津贴到账后的那天吗？

words.enDefinition: the day when an account officially records a transaction

examples.en: The posting date was Tuesday, although I sent the transfer on Friday.
examples.zh: 尽管我星期五就转账了，「入账日期」却是星期二。

examples.en: The agent compared the posting date with the date printed on my receipt.
examples.zh: 中介把「入账日期」和我收据上印的日期对照了一下。

words.enDefinition: a mistake in the amount or account being charged

examples.en: A billing error made it look as though I owed two months of rent.
examples.zh: 一个「账单错误」让我看起来欠了两个月房租。

examples.en: The office fixed the billing error after I forwarded my previous rent receipt.
examples.zh: 我转发上次的房租收据后，办公室更正了「账单错误」。

words.enDefinition: not paid by the deadline specified for payment

examples.en: The portal marked my rent as past due before my transfer had cleared.
examples.zh: 转账还没结算，平台就把我的房租标为「已逾期」。

examples.en: I called the office because July still showed as past due on my account.
examples.zh: 因为账户上的七月房租依然显示「已逾期」，我给办公室打了电话。

collocations: mark a payment as past due

words.enDefinition: an account with no overdue obligations or other restrictions

examples.en: The new payment option is available to any tenant with an account in good standing.
examples.zh: 租客的「账户状态正常」，就可以用这种新的付款方式。

examples.en: I needed an account in good standing to spread my rent over three months.
examples.zh: 只有「账户状态正常」，我才能把房租分三个月付。

collocations: keep an account in good standing
maintain an account in good standing
an account in good standing with the landlord

words.enDefinition: failure to pay the housing amount owed under a rental arrangement

examples.en: The notice cited nonpayment of rent, so I collected my receipts and called the agent.
examples.zh: 通知上写着「未支付租金」，于是我整理好收据，给中介打了电话。

examples.en: I spoke to a housing adviser about a dispute over nonpayment of rent.
examples.zh: 我为一起「未支付租金」的纠纷咨询了住宿顾问。

collocations: a notice for nonpayment of rent
a dispute over nonpayment of rent

words.enDefinition: an arrangement to hold rent separately while a dispute is resolved

examples.en: A legal clinic explained what rent escrow meant during my dispute with the landlord.
examples.zh: 我和房东发生纠纷时，法律援助机构给我解释了什么是「租金托管」。

examples.en: I asked whether rent escrow was available where my student apartment was located.
examples.zh: 我问了学生公寓所在地是否可以申请「租金托管」。

words.enDefinition: keep back an otherwise due rent payment, often during a dispute

examples.en: I asked a housing adviser before deciding whether to withhold rent over the repairs.
examples.zh: 我要不要因为维修问题「暂缓交租」，先问了住宿顾问。

examples.en: My flatmate wanted to withhold rent until the owner responded to our emails.
examples.zh: 室友想在房东回复我们邮件之前「暂缓交租」。

words.enDefinition: make a payment while formally stating that you dispute it

examples.en: I decided to pay under protest while the housing office reviewed the disputed charge.
examples.zh: 住宿办公室审查有争议的费用期间，我决定「先付款并保留异议」。

examples.en: My adviser explained how to pay under protest and keep a written record.
examples.zh: 顾问告诉我怎样「先付款并保留异议」，同时留好书面记录。

words.enDefinition: money paid back to someone for rent they covered

examples.en: I requested rent reimbursement for the month I spent on a research placement.
examples.zh: 我申请「房租报销」，报的是外出做科研的那一个月。

examples.en: The university needs my rent receipt before it can approve rent reimbursement.
examples.zh: 学校需要我的房租收据才能批准「房租报销」。

words.enDefinition: pay back a roommate for money they spent for you

examples.en: I had to reimburse a roommate after she covered the whole rent payment.
examples.zh: 室友垫付了整笔房租，我得「把自己那份还给她」。

examples.en: Can I reimburse a roommate by check if my bank app stops working?
examples.zh: 如果银行应用打不开，我能用支票「把垫付款还给室友」吗？

words.enDefinition: reduce the amount owed by making payments toward it

examples.en: I used my weekend wages to pay down the balance on my rent account.
examples.zh: 我用周末打工挣的钱「偿还一部分」房租账户里的欠款。

examples.en: We can pay down the balance a little faster during the summer break.
examples.zh: 暑假期间我们可以更快一点「还清剩下的欠款」。

collocations: make extra payments to pay down the balance

words.enDefinition: digital proof that a payment was received

examples.en: The portal sent an electronic receipt as soon as my rent went through.
examples.zh: 房租一付成功，平台就发来了「电子收据」。

examples.en: I saved my electronic receipt in the folder with my other housing documents.
examples.zh: 我把「电子收据」放在了存其他住房文件的文件夹里。

words.enDefinition: take a check to the recipient in person

examples.en: I can hand-deliver a check to the office after my morning seminar.
examples.zh: 上午研讨课结束后，我可以去办公室「当面递交支票」。

examples.en: We decided to hand-deliver a check after the mail service reported delays.
examples.zh: 得知邮递延误后，我们决定「当面递交支票」。

collocations: hand-deliver a check to the office

words.enDefinition: write the name of a particular recipient on a check

examples.en: Please make the check out to the university, not to your residence adviser.
examples.zh: 请把「支票收款人写成」大学，而不是宿舍管理员。

examples.en: Should I make the check out to the owner or the rental company?
examples.zh: 我应该把「支票收款人写成」房东还是租赁公司？

collocations: say who to make the check out to
make the check out to the landlord
make the check out to the housing office

words.enDefinition: a note on a check explaining what it pays for

examples.en: I wrote my apartment number in the check memo so they could identify it.
examples.zh: 我把公寓门牌号写在「支票备注」里，好让对方知道是哪户付的。

examples.en: The office asked me to put my student number in the check memo.
examples.zh: 办公室让我在「支票备注」里填上学号。

collocations: write the apartment number in the check memo
